doc.title: Monthly Updates [March]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added custom search engines (CSE) for Courses and Fonts.

  • Added a section for Productivity Tools in Useful Sites.

  • Added a section for File Recovery in File Tools.

  • Added a section for Fingerprinting / Tracking in Privacy.

  • Added sections for Mario Kart + Geometry Dash in Gaming.

  • Added a section for Crypto / Bitcoin in Career.

  • Added a section for Raspberry Pi in Linux.

  • Added sections for Design Apps + Design Assets in Image Tools.

  • Our Minecraft Server is now live. Click here to join.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred yet another music server in Audio Downloading. Multi-site DDL (Deezer, Qobuz, Tidal, Spotify, YouTube, FLAC).

  • Starred wrtn in Online Chatbots. No-limit GPT-4; tell it to always talk in English.

  • Starred M4UFree + YesMovies in Streaming. Both have huge libraries, fast 1080p, and have been around for over a decade.

  • Starred Poe in Image Generators. 100 SDXL and 100 Playground gens.

  • Starred Simply Optimized in Minecraft Optimization. Some prefer this to Fabulously Optimized.

  • Starred SolidTorrents in Torrent Aggregators.

  • Starred MrGamingStreams in Live TV. Fast streams, nice UI, no ads.

  • Starred 720pier in Sports Streaming. Sport replay torrents.

  • Starred Enhancer for YT in YouTube Customization. YouTube enhancement extension.

  • Starred RatS in Tracking / Discovery. Sync media ratings between sites.

Things Removed

  • Removed Vendetta from Android as the devs have shut it down.

  • Removed TTV LOL as it stopped working.

  • Unstarred bypass.vip and FastForward as they don't work as well as they used to.

  • Unstarred Claude in chatbots as it requires email + phone number and doesn't give as good results as it used to.

  • Unstarred Harmonoid as it's no longer being updated and has 100+ issues on GitHub.
